title: Renewal & Redline Cheatsheet (personal scratchpad)
content:
Quick context:
- Personal scratchpad for day-to-day invoice checks, contract redlines, and renewal reminders. Use this as a rapid triage / memory aid before I transfer items into formal tickets or calendar invites.

Today (2024-12-03) — snapshot:
- Morning inbox: 3 vendor invoices (INV-2091, INV-2094, INV-2102) — flag 2094 (missing PO)
- Contract queue: 2 NDAs, 1 MSA with redlines from Vendor: NovusAI (needs indemnity/limitation language)
- Renewals: CDN provider auto-renews 2025-01-15 — check SLA/overage caps

Immediate checklist (what I can do in 30–60m):
- [ ] INV-2094: confirm PO, email AP (calc impact if delayed) — draft email below
- [ ] Create JIRA ticket FIN-AP for late invoice (attach invoice screenshot)
- [ ] Quick redline for NovusAI MSA: add mutual indemnity language, tighten data residency clause
- [ ] Put CDN renewal on calendar + request latest usage report from infra-team
- [ ] Send renewal notice draft to vendor-contact; cc: Marcus Li

Invoice triage notes:
- INV-2091 (Platform monitoring): USD 3,600 — OK, matches PO 6782, to pay normal cadence
- INV-2094 (Consulting – discovery): USD 24,000 — NO PO attached, contract says pre-approved SOW required; hold and escalate to PM (Lina)
- INV-2102 (Cloud infra): credit memos attached, reconcile with month-end statement
- Rules of thumb for quick decisions: <30k and PO present -> route to AP. >30k or missing PO -> hold + escalate.

Contract redline cheat snippets (copy/paste friendly):
- Indemnity (mutual, limited): "Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party from third-party claims arising from the indemnifying party's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Liability under this Section shall be subject to the limitations set forth in Section [X]."
- Limitation of Liability (cap): "Except for liability arising from a party's breach of confidentiality, indemnification obligations, or willful misconduct, each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim."
- Data residency: "Vendor shall not transfer or process Customer Personal Data outside the EEA without Customer's prior written consent. Where such transfer is required, Vendor must implement standard contractual clauses or an equivalent lawful transfer mechanism."
- Auto-renewal / Termination: "This Agreement will automatically renew for successive one (1) year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term."
- SLA / credits: "Availability credit shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for outages and Vendor shall provide service credits as set forth in Exhibit B; Vendor's failure to meet SLOs for three (3) consecutive months shall entitle Customer to terminate for convenience with pro rata refund."

Redline strategy notes (personal):
- Prioritize clauses that create cash or compliance risk: payment/PO, auto-renew, termination, data residency, indemnity, third-party reliance.
- Keep language neutral when possible; offer alternatives rather than hard deletes in early rounds.
- For vendor templates: track what's non-negotiable vs what's bargaining room.

Renewals tracker (short list):
- CDN provider — Renewal: 2025-01-15 — Owner: Avery — Action: request usage report by 2024-12-10, propose cap review if >20% increase
- Monitoring SaaS — Renewal: 2025-02-02 — Owner: SRE — Action: confirm license usage and volume discounts
- Legal research databases — Renewal: 2025-03-01 — Owner: Legal — Action: check EDU/volume pricing options

Email templates / quick drafts (for copy/paste):
- To AP (missing PO):
  Subject: Invoice INV-2094 – PO missing / need approval
  Hi Asha,
  We received invoice INV-2094 (Consulting, 11/2024) for $24,000 but there is no PO attached and SOW approval is not in the system. Can you confirm if a PO exists or if we should hold payment pending PM sign-off? Attaching invoice PDF.
  Thx,
  Avery

- To vendor (renewal notice):
  Subject: Renewal and usage question — CDN account
  Hi Jordan,
  Quick check — our current term is set to auto-renew on 2025-01-15. Can you share December usage and any forecasted price/overage changes? Also confirm our current SLA and any planned maintenance windows in Q1.
  Best,
  Avery

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Does Legal want to push for mutual indemnity on NovusAI, or accept vendor-proposed limited form? (ask in LEGAL-ops weekly)
- Confirm internal PO policy threshold with Finance — is $20k or $25k the hard cutoff now? (I recall a change in Q3)
- Who on SRE can quickly pull CDN usage by tag? Ping: @Marcus Li

Micro daily log (timeboxed notes):
- 09:10 — triage inbox + mark INV-2094 hold
- 10:05 — quick call with PM Lina (5m) about SOW for INV-2094
- 11:30 — drafted NovusAI redline and saved to Legal draft folder (will formalize later)
- 14:20 — asked infra for CDN usage, tagged Marcus
